topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: I can't rightly say how the earth shall shift under my feet, now that I've learned of my closest friend's departure. The land, it’s known to change, but in slow, steady ways, like the seasons turning. This feels different, like a sudden storm that comes when the sky shows no sign of rain. How will the days fill without his voice? The mornings, the evenings, the endless toil in the fields, all the while with silence where laughter used to be. Saints above, the harvests will come and go, and I’ll be here, working the soil, while he’s far away, across mountains and seas. What to do, when the one who tills the earth alongside you is gone? The tasks won’t stop, but everything will feel a little colder, a little harder, a little more alone.
